scenario: AITA for asking for more per-diem? | I'm a woman working in a career that's about 98% male. I am the first woman my company has ever hired. A few guys choose keep the money and sleep in their cars, or take a long commute home every night if it's 2 hours or less. I was asked to go on a job 4hrs away, 12 hour shifts, so commuting each day is not an option. I'm not comfortable sharing a room with men I don't know well, or sleeping in my car. I called the project manager and said I'd go if he increased the per-diem enough to pay for a single room. He said yes. My male coworkers are now mad that I 'asked for special treatment' and shared rooms are 'just how things are done in this industry'. I feel that if they wanted their own rooms, no one has ever stopped them from asking. AITA?
